profiling.max_top_values_comment: Max distinct values per column included in profile JSON (categorical_top_values) and in prompt top-value lines. Recommendation: 5–15. Lower = smaller prompt; higher = richer hints for low-cardinality fields.
profiling.high_null_threshold_pct_comment: Columns with at least this percent null/empty ('-' counts as empty) are listed as high_null_columns in the profile. Recommendation: 85–95 for herbarium CSVs with many sparse annotation fields.
profiling.sample_rows_default_comment: Default row count for sample_collection.py when --n is omitted. Recommendation: 5–12. Used for exploration, not for final answers (use query_collection.py for facts).
profiling.prompt_sample_rows_comment: Number of diverse example rows embedded per collection in build_prompt.py. Recommendation: 2–5. Keep low to save prompt budget (~2 MiB total cap).
profiling.large_file_threshold_mb_comment: CSV files at or above this size on disk use sampled profiling (line count + stats from first profile_sample_rows only). Recommendation: 2 MB aligns with prompt context budget; do not raise thinking a 1M context window can hold the file.
profiling.profile_sample_rows_comment: Rows read from disk for stats when large_file_threshold_mb applies (and for prompt sampling on large files). Recommendation: 5000–20000. Higher = more accurate sampled stats but slower and more RAM.
profiling.prompt_max_columns_listed_comment: Max column names appended to profile_summary in the system prompt. Recommendation: 30–53 (all columns if small collections). Truncates the list only in prompt text, not in stored profile JSON.
profiling.prompt_key_columns_for_top_values_commen: Columns for which top value counts are inlined into profile_summary in the prompt (must exist in CSV). Recommendation: pick 4–8 high-signal fields per collection type; avoid huge free-text columns.
profiling.prompt_sample_cell_max_len_comment: Max characters per cell in prompt sample_rows (long ontology JSON is truncated). Recommendation: 60–120. Lower = smaller prompt; higher = more readable samples.
profiling.prompt_max_chars_per_collection_comment: Soft cap on characters for one collection block inside {{COLLECTIONS_BLOCK}}. Recommendation: 4000–10000. Many collections share prompt.max_total_chars (~2 MiB); lower per collection if you have dozens of folders.
